title: Server rendering survives effects, and check reports defects that only failed at runtime
why: Apps returned an empty response (proxy 502) when an fx started a server call or navigate() during server rendering, and several defects passed check, doctor and build but failed only at runtime: a duplicate declaration in load(), a local hiding an import, view props without load().
changelog: `navigate()` is a no-op on the server
gets its FAQPage when the `faq` group
written in `public/` is the one published
